statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient loss of consciousness and brief neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study, CPT code 93226, is ordered
The study is to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other rhythm disturbances
The rhythm disturbances may be contributing to syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion
The diagnoses are R55 and G45.9
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
